name: Chef Boyardyev
teaser: Every food and drink item in tarkov for sale at an adjustable price to reduce misery of no flea playthroughs
description_html: Since BSG refuses to add food to traders for the first half of the game I guess it’s up to me to step in and do it. Chef Boyardyev sells every food and drink item in the game at their handbook price multiplied by the price multiplier in the config files. No loyalty requirements or flea required. If you feel like his prices are unreasonable(too high OR too low) just open config.json and edit the “itempricemultiplier” line as you please(1 is 1x multiplier, you can set this to a non whole number like 2.3 if you want 230% or 0.2 if you want 20% prices as well)
